beats.say: Its poop comes out shaped like little cubes.
The wombat. A chunky digger from Australia.
Every night, it leaves eighty to a hundred cubes.
The end of its gut has stiff spots and stretchy spots.
Those squeeze the poop into corners, as it dries.
That study won an Ig Nobel Prize.
It leaves its cubes on rocks and logs, to mark its turf.
Square poop, and science figured out how.
